description: Entering client data; preparing and reviewing individual and business returns; extensions; e-file transmission and acknowledgments
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Filing season (February to April) and the April 15 and October 15 deadlines; about $1,700 of fees per business day in season; in the last week before a deadline the MTD drops to 24 hours. RPO set by the tax software vendor's backups (SOC 2 report: RPO 1 hour)
manual_workaround: File extensions for clients who cannot be finished (Form 4868 on paper if e-file is unavailable); reschedule client meetings; prepare nothing on paper
dependent_third_parties: Tax software vendor (hosting and transmission); IRS and state e-file systems; internet provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: CPA-owner (single point of failure: only preparer, signer, and EFIN Responsible Official); home office

business_process: Client document intake, e-signature, and return delivery
description: Receiving source documents through the portal, email, text photos, and paper drop-off; Form 8879 and engagement letter e-signature; delivering completed returns
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A return cannot be transmitted until the client signs Form 8879 (IRS Pub. 1345); documents arrive daily in season. RPO 24 hours relies on the portal vendor's backups and the email suite's 30-day version history; there is no independent backup of email and files (P01 R-012)
manual_workaround: Paper drop-off and mailed Forms 8879 (Pub. 1345 allows hand delivery, mail, fax, or email); ask clients to re-send documents
dependent_third_parties: Tax software vendor (portal); email and file suite provider; internet provider

business_process: Client communications and IRS notice representation
description: Email and phone with clients; answering IRS and state notices under powers of attorney; IRS transcript requests
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Clients call and email daily in season; IRS notice response dates are usually weeks away, so a few days' outage is tolerable outside the deadline weeks
manual_workaround: Phone calls from the mobile phone; respond to notices by mail or fax; ask the IRS for more time where the notice allows it
dependent_third_parties: Email and file suite provider; phone carrier

business_process: Bookkeeping and payroll support for small-business clients
description: Monthly bookkeeping in clients' own accounting files; preparing payroll data and payroll tax filings for 12 clients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client payroll dates and payroll tax deposit dates; clients can run payroll themselves in their own payroll services for one cycle
manual_workaround: Clients run payroll from their own payroll service using last cycle's data; the owner catches up the books afterward
dependent_third_parties: Clients' accounting and payroll SaaS providers

description: Invoices and client payments; engagement letters; the firm's own books, PTIN and EFIN renewals, insurance, and licensing
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Administrative deadlines are measured in weeks; fees can be billed late
manual_workaround: Paper invoices and checks; use the vendor portals directly when the laptop is unavailable
dependent_third_parties: Practice management vendor; accounting SaaS vendor
